column1: Detailed tables: Midterm voting preference, October 2026
Pew Research Center survey of U.S. adults conducted Sept. 28-Oct. 4, 2026.
Full report: With Americans in a Sour Mood, Democratic Voters Are More Engaged in Midterms
% of registered voters who say they would vote for/lean toward the __ for the U.S. House of Representatives in their district
* Estimates for Asian adults are representative of English speakers only.
** Relatively small sample size for Black voters with a college degree or more (N=106, margin of error +/- 10.0 percentage points at 95% confidence).

Note: Based on registered voters. White, Black and Asian adults include those who report only being one race and are not Hispanic. Hispanics are of any race. Validated Trump and Harris voters are adult citizens for whom a record of voting was found in official state election records. Vote choice was collected in surveys conducted the week after the 2024 election. Nonvoters include those who did not vote in 2024 but were eligible to do so, as well as those who were not eligible to vote. Insufficient sample size to show education breaks among Asian voters. No answer responses are not shown.
Source: Survey of U.S. adults conducted Sept. 28-Oct. 4, 2026.
